A reflection after an act; a later or subsequent thought, action, or expedient.
d.e: She packed her sandals only as an afterthought, but she was glad she did.

d.t: Something additional to the original plan or concept.
d.e: This whole remodeling was an afterthought; we were only going to paint and call it good.

d.t: To expound as an afterthought.
Pressure sensitivity on an electronic synthesizer, allowing the musician to change the tone or sound of a note after it is struck.
A touch (feature or characteristic) added finally or as an afterthought.
